C0030.title: A Scalping Anomaly Detection Method Based on Mobile Internet Traffic Data
C0030.summary: This study proposes a scalping anomaly detection method named SADM for identifying scalper behaviors in online retail. It highlights that scalping is a critical issue for online retailers, as it unfairly monopolizes product resources through illegitimate means.
